lines.text: When the water came, everyone left Lagos.
Everyone except Baba Ayo. He had a bus, a route, and thirty years of habit.
So every morning he drove Route 7. He stopped at every stop, and he waited.
Then one evening, at the last stop, someone did.
Where are you going, my daughter?
Anywhere. I didn't want to be alone tonight.
Then you are on the right bus.
My first fare in two years.
